column1: Cut the butter into small pieces and melt in a large skillet over medium heat.
When the butter foams, add the sage leaves.
Cook, stirring gently, until the white milk solids settle and the butter turns a golden honey color; watch closely so it does not brown.
Transfer cooked pasta straight into the pan with some cooking water still clinging to it.
Toss, adding splashes of pasta water as needed to make a glossy sauce.
Serve right away topped with the crispy sage leaves.
